titel: Liquor? I Hardly Know Her | WWDD/Heauxmetown Heroes w/ Katie Maloney & Dayna Kathan

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Unapologetic talk on drinking habits, wild tanning salon stories, and listener advice.
kurzfassung: Katie Maloney and Dana Kathan kick off the episode sharing drinks and reminiscing about wild college drinking games and Four Lokos. They read listener stories covering everything from bizarre tanning salon encounters to emotional relationship dilemmas. Throughout the show, the hosts offer unfiltered advice and plenty of laughs while connecting with their community.
stichpunkte: The hosts share nostalgic and chaotic stories about drinking Four Lokos and playing extreme college drinking games.
A listener writes in with wild memories from working at a tanning salon, including people misbehaving in the booths.
A reader shares a heartwarming proposal story involving a running joke about dating a 30-year-old.
Another listener recounts the horrifying experience of a passenger masturbating next to her mother on a flight.
Katie and Dana address a listener whose boyfriend posted an unprofessional photo with a student online.
A young listener writes about breaking up due to cultural differences, prompting advice on resilience and moving on.

clips.hook: Almost blacked out at a Padres game
clips.text: The speaker recalls a past baseball game where consuming only a few canned alcoholic beverages led to an extremely heavy level of intoxication.

clips.hook: A drunken tongue speaks the sober mind
clips.text: A tipsy host misquotes a famous philosophical saying while reflecting on honesty during the recording.
